findings.title: ExternalName Service names an IP address
findings.cause: Service legacy-db is of type ExternalName with externalName 10.96.200.15, an IP address: cluster DNS answers legacy-db.kd-externalname-ip.svc with a CNAME to the name "10.96.200.15", which does not resolve, so clients of the Service get no address

evidence.what: Service legacy-db has type ExternalName and externalName 10.96.200.15
evidence.command: kubectl get service legacy-db -n kd-externalname-ip -o jsonpath='{.spec.type}{" "}{.spec.externalName}'

findings.fix: ExternalName takes a DNS name. To send Service legacy-db to the address 10.96.200.15, make it a Service without a selector and give it an EndpointSlice with that address.
